zh: 模型方案的「校验 HTTPS 证书」改为默认不校验，新建方案即可直连内网自签证书网关（已保存的方案保持原设置）；只开放了月报、没开放数据导入的成员，现在也能正常使用月报资料库、Logo、预设、草稿和文档。
en: "Verify HTTPS certificate" on model profiles is now off by default, so new profiles reach self-signed internal gateways directly (saved profiles keep their setting); members who only have the monthly report shared, not data import, can now use the monthly library, logos, presets, drafts and documents.
